It is open Monday to Saturday from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and on Sundays from 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM. The library is closed on national holidays unless a special notification is issued. The university has a network of over 10 subject-specific libraries linked to the central system, covering Engineering, Medical, Pharmacy, Management, Law, and other disciplines. Students can borrow books using their library card, which is issued at the library counter on the ground floor of C1. The library offers digital resources, e-journals, research databases, NPTEL access, and dedicated reading rooms. Photocopying and printing services are available inside the library. Students must maintain silence inside and must carry their university ID card at all times. Books can be renewed online or at the counter. Late return of books attracts a fine per day.
